content: SheetJS (xlsx npm package) is the dominant JS library for parsing/generating XLSX/CSV (~7.8M weekly downloads), works both server-side (Node) and client-side (browser), handles messy real-world uploaded files well. Security note for 2026: since it parses arbitrary user uploads, treat it as attack surface — pin exact version, validate/limit input size, and read from a Buffer rather than trusting raw file paths. For export, generate the workbook with XLSX.write and stream the buffer in the HTTP response with correct Excel content-type headers; for client-only export needs, the same library also works in-browser via blobs, or a lighter alternative like PapaParse can be used for plain CSV-only needs.
